summary: Added the fleet list command as engine/fleet-cli.ts (run: bun run engine/fleet-cli.ts, with a --registry test seam): it reads the fleet registry, prune-on-read drops dead-pid and vanished-poolDir entries, prints one plain line per live pool as `poolDir -> http://localhost:<port>` and `no live consoles` (exit 0) when nothing is live, and never rewrites the registry. New engine/fleet-cli.test.ts spawns the real CLI against temp registries with live/spare pids and pins the read-only behavior. 183 tests, typecheck, and UI build all clean.
